name: GOHUB
recent: Go Hub Capital 于10月初获得 KTMB 旗下价值约 RM64.79 million 的票务系统维护与支持合约。公司同时有多项公司秘书及董事委员会成员变动，并披露一名独立非执行董事在9月8日减持股份。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收与净利均同比增长。
notable: 获得 KTMB 旗下公司价值约 RM64.79 million 的票务系统维护与支持服务合约。
委任及更换多名公司秘书，涉及 Cheng Chia Ping、Tee Zhen Wan、Khaw Teik Thye、Chua Siew Chuan、Chong Lay Kim。
独立非执行董事 Alief Iskandar bin Mohd Zuhri 于9月8日出售 412,900 股普通股。
risks: 独立非执行董事在9月8日减持 412,900 股，占已发行股份约 0.094%。
公司于8月至10月间多次公告提供财务援助（Provision of Financial Assistance）。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 RM15.403 million，环比增长8.3%，同比增长37.0%；净利为 RM1.806 million，环比增长1.7%，同比增长24.3%；净利率为11.7%，上一季度为12.5%。

recent_en: Go Hub Capital secured a contract worth approximately RM64.79 million from a KTMB unit in early October for ticketing system maintenance and support services. The company also saw several changes of company secretary and board committee members, and disclosed that an independent non-executive director disposed of shares on 8 September. Revenue and net profit both grew year-on-year in the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Secured a contract worth approximately RM64.79 million from a KTMB unit for ticketing system maintenance and support services.
Appointed and changed several company secretaries, involving Cheng Chia Ping, Tee Zhen Wan, Khaw Teik Thye, Chua Siew Chuan and Chong Lay Kim.
Independent non-executive director Alief Iskandar bin Mohd Zuhri disposed of 412,900 ordinary shares on 8 September.
risks_en: An independent non-executive director disposed of 412,900 shares on 8 September, representing about 0.094% of issued shares.
The company announced the provision of financial assistance several times between August and October.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM15.403 million, up 8.3% quarter-on-quarter and 37.0% year-on-year; net profit was RM1.806 million, up 1.7% quarter-on-quarter and 24.3% year-on-year; net margin was 11.7% versus 12.5% in the previous quarter.
